extracted.name: Bushwacker
extracted.description: Coffee liqueur, coconut rum, Irish cream, vodka and amaretto (whew!) mixed with coconut cream.
instruction_lines: In a one-quart blender half filled with ice, combine coffee liqueur, rum, Irish cream, vodka, amaretto and coconut cream. Blend until smooth. Pour into cup and sprinkle a little nutmeg on top and enjoy a little taste of the Islands.
